title: 1 PDF -> Podcast, Slide Deck & Mind Map with NotebookLM's Studio Panel
tldr: Upload one PDF to NotebookLM and the Studio panel can turn it into a two-host podcast, a slide deck, and an interactive mind map.
Each output comes from the same uploaded sources -- no separate podcast editor, slide app, or mind-mapping tool needed.

snippets.label: What to upload first
snippets.code: Any single PDF, report, or long article you already have sitting in a folder.

tips: Start with one source before adding more -- it's faster to sanity-check a single Audio Overview or Mind Map.
Use the Slide Deck revision option to fix any slide instead of regenerating the whole deck.
mistakes: Expecting one single prompt to generate all three outputs at once -- each is its own Studio panel action on the same upload.
